annotations.title: Look up a Georgia Code section

description: One section of the Official Code of Georgia Annotated (O.C.G.A.) by citation in any written form (44-7-34, 'O.C.G.A. § 44-7-34', 'Title 44, Chapter 7, Section 34'), as the same Markdown twin the site serves: frontmatter (cite_as, canonical_url, source_url, status, version), the verbatim text, then the notes capped. `version` picks a printed version by its qualifier; `subsection` ('a', 'a-1') renders one part. Returns at most `max_chars` characters (default 60,000), ending with the call for the next part. A citation not found names the neighboring sections.

citation.description: One Code section in any written form: 44-7-34, O.C.G.A. § 44-7-34, Title 44, Chapter 7, Section 34, or with a subsection, 44-7-34(a).
citation.title: Citation

max_chars.description: Most characters to return in this call, 1,000 to 200,000 (default 60,000). A longer document ends with a pointer to the next part.
max_chars.title: Max Chars

start.description: Where to start, as returned by the previous call's continuation pointer. 0 is the beginning.
start.title: Start

subsection.description: One subsection to render alone, by its label: a, a-1, b.
subsection.title: Subsection

version.description: Which printed version, by words of its effective-date qualifier, when a section is printed in more than one.
version.title: Version

name: code_lookup_section
title: Look up a Georgia Code section
